claims: C1 the heading 'Follow all applicable instructions' carries root authority
C2 every rule in this section is a root-level instruction

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: the rule carries root authority, the highest level in the authority hierarchy, assigned to Model Spec 'root' sections

concepts.name: authority_levels_hierarchy
concepts.gloss: the ranking of instruction authority levels: root > system > developer > user > guideline > no authority, used to determine which instruction prevails in conflicts

concepts.name: rule_under_heading
concepts.gloss: the rule is located under the named heading in the document
concepts.inference: the node speaks of the rules under a heading, so a relation between a rule and a heading must exist

concepts.name: follow_all_applicable_instructions_heading
concepts.gloss: the document heading 'Follow all applicable instructions'

ontology.gloss: R is a rule under the 'Follow all applicable instructions' heading and therefore carries root authority
